patches.title: Hold Object Before Sink
patches.principle: Only go to the sink if you are already holding the object to be cleaned.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning an object.

patches.title: Clean Then Place Directly
patches.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination and place the object without any detours.

patches.title: Start Countertop for Clean
patches.principle: When searching for an object to clean, first check all countertops and open surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a clean task.
